test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Each of the players (1)/ were expected to follow (2)/ the code of conduct (3)/ strictly. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**Each of the players**," is singular, as the phrase "each of" indicates that we are referring to individual members of a group.
 
• The verb "**were**" is plural and does not agree with the singular subject "**Each**."
 
• The correct verb should be "**was**" instead of "**were**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Each of the players **was** expected to follow the code of conduct strictly."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Each of the players"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "the code of conduct"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "strictly"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
